name: project_shop
description: Two revenues (gross vs net) and two actives (status A vs A+T). Clarify items must not silently pick one.

items.question: How many customers are in the customers table?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers

items.question: How many customers live in Texas?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE state = 'TX'

items.question: List customer names in California
items.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE state = 'CA'

items.question: How many customers have status A?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE status = 'A'

items.question: How many orders are there?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders

items.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND created_at < DATE '2025-01-01'

items.question: How many orders did Alice place?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Alice'

items.question: What is total gross revenue from order line items?
items.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(qty * unit_price) AS gross FROM order_items

items.question: What is total net revenue after refunds?
items.gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty * unit_price), 0) FROM order_items) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE kind = 'refund') AS net

items.question: What is the sum of refund amounts in payments?
items.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS refunds FROM payments WHERE kind = 'refund'

items.question: What is the sum of charge amounts in payments?
items.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS charges FROM payments WHERE kind = 'charge'

items.question: How many order line items are there?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items

items.question: What is gross revenue from order items for orders placed in 2024?
items.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.qty * i.unit_price) AS gross FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < DATE '2025-01-01'

items.question: How many orders were placed by customers in Texas?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.state = 'TX'

items.question: For each customer name, how many orders did they place?
items.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS n FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

items.question: What is the average unit price on order items?
items.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price FROM order_items

items.question: What is the highest qty on any order item?
items.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(qty) AS max_qty FROM order_items

items.question: List names of customers with status I
items.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE status = 'I'

items.question: How many customers have status T?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE status = 'T'

items.question: How many payment rows are there?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments

items.question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'

items.question: How many orders did Dan place?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Dan'
